name: Skeptic
reason: Heat and a satellite uptick are real, but a 0.021 index is still low, history shows no June blooms, and 22 mm of rain with no heavy-rain days is hardly a nutrient flood, so I'll concede some risk but not a bloom.
evidence: cyano_index 0.021 is a low absolute value, even with +0.016 vs last week
bloom_rate_this_month_past_years 0.0, so no June precedent in the record
max_temp_avg 31.8 with 6 hot days does favor growth, which I grudgingly concede
rain_last_14d_mm 23.0 with 0 heavy_rain_days suggests modest runoff and little nutrient pulse
